dedupe_keys.name: ministry of water resources of china data bulletins water resources water development statistics hydrology flood and drought

description: The data section of the website of the Ministry of Water Resources of China publishes the ministry's statistical bulletins, searchable by year from 2016 and by type. The recommended series are the bulletin of the first national water census, which covered rivers and lakes, water projects, major water users and water agencies at the end of 2011; the national water development statistical bulletins from 2007 to 2025; the China water resources bulletin on precipitation, water resources, reservoir and lake storage, groundwater and water use; the China hydrological yearbook; the river sediment, flood and drought disaster defence, soil and water conservation and Three Gorges project bulletins; and a monthly groundwater dynamics report. Coverage is mainland China. Access is free online as web pages and bulletin documents. Caveats: these are reports with summary figures, not asset-level data, no licence was stated, and the pages are in Chinese. Simulation uses: national water supply and demand, irrigation and flood defence planning context, and calibration totals for water balance models. Related records: the China flood disaster impact database (data-cfdid-china-flood-disaster-impact-database) and IrriMap_CN (data-irrimap-cn-annual-irrigation-maps-china).
